quiz.q: When should a forklift be checked for damage?
quiz.a_en: Before every use — a pre-operational (pre-start) inspection at the start of each shift and each time you change operators. Also check during operation, after any impact or incident, at the end of the shift, and at the intervals set by the manufacturer's service schedule.
quiz.a_ru: Перед каждым использованием — предэксплуатационная проверка в начале смены и при смене оператора. Также в процессе работы, после любого удара/инцидента, в конце смены и по регламенту производителя.
key: Before every use — pre-start inspection
At the start of each shift and at every change of operator
During operation and after any impact or incident
At the end of the shift and at the manufacturer's service intervals
options: Before every use — pre-start check at the start of each shift, at each change of operator, after any impact, and at service intervals
Once a week by the maintenance department; the operator only reports faults
Only when a fault light comes on or the forklift feels different to drive
At the annual inspection required for the High Risk Work licence
quiz.explain_ru: Проверка — перед каждым использованием: начало смены, смена оператора, после удара, по регламенту. Не раз в неделю и не только по лампочке.

quiz.q: List 7 items that you should check when undertaking a pre-operational check of the forklift.
quiz.a_en: (1) Tyres and wheels — condition, pressure, nuts. (2) Fork arms and carriage — cracks, wear, locking pins. (3) Mast, chains and hydraulic rams — tension, leaks, damage. (4) Hydraulic hoses and fluid levels — oil, coolant, fuel/battery, hydraulic oil. (5) Data plate (capacity plate) and all decals present and legible. (6) Seat, seatbelt and operator restraint. (7) Overhead guard and load backrest — secure, undamaged. (Also: horn, lights, beacon, mirrors, fire extinguisher, no leaks under machine.)
quiz.a_ru: (1) Шины и колёса. (2) Вилы и каретка — трещины, износ, фиксаторы. (3) Мачта, цепи, гидроцилиндры. (4) Шланги и уровни жидкостей. (5) Заводская табличка (data plate) и наклейки. (6) Сиденье и ремень. (7) Защитная крыша и спинка каретки. Плюс: сигнал, свет, маячок, зеркала, огнетушитель, подтёки под машиной.
key: Tyres and wheels
Fork arms and carriage — cracks, wear, locking pins
Mast, chains, hydraulic rams
Hoses and fluid levels — oil, coolant, fuel, hydraulic
Data plate and decals legible
Seat, seatbelt, operator restraint
Overhead guard and load backrest
options: Tyres, fork arms, mast and chains, fluid levels, data plate, seatbelt, overhead guard
Engine horsepower, paint condition, radio reception, cup holder, floor mats, air conditioning, odometer
Only the items the supervisor nominates on the day
Tyres, forks and fuel — the rest is checked by the mechanic at service
quiz.explain_ru: Семь пунктов pre-start: шины, вилы и каретка, мачта и цепи, жидкости и шланги, data plate, ремень и сиденье, защитная крыша и спинка каретки.

quiz.q: List all guards on your forklift and their functions.
quiz.a_en: • Overhead guard (ROPS/FOPS) — protects the operator from falling objects and in a roll-over. • Load backrest extension — stops the load falling backwards onto the operator. • Fan belt / engine guard — prevents contact with moving belts and pulleys. • Chain and sprocket guard on the mast — prevents entanglement. • Exhaust / muffler guard — prevents burns. • Seatbelt and operator restraint system — keeps the operator inside the protective zone.
quiz.a_ru: • Защитная крыша (ROPS/FOPS) — от падающих предметов и при опрокидывании. • Спинка каретки — груз не упадёт на оператора. • Кожух ремня/двигателя — от вращающихся частей. • Кожух цепей мачты — от затягивания. • Кожух выхлопа — от ожогов. • Ремень безопасности — удерживает оператора в защитной зоне.
key: Overhead guard (ROPS/FOPS) — falling objects, roll-over
Load backrest extension — load falling back onto operator
Fan belt / engine guard — moving belts and pulleys
Chain and sprocket guard on the mast — entanglement
Exhaust / muffler guard — burns
Seatbelt / operator restraint — keeps you inside the protective zone
options: Overhead guard, load backrest extension, fan belt guard, chain guard, exhaust guard, seatbelt
Front bumper, tow bar, mud flaps, number plate, sun visor
Overhead guard and load backrest only — the rest are optional accessories
Side mirrors, rear-view camera, reversing alarm and beacon
quiz.explain_ru: Guards — это защитные элементы: крыша, спинка каретки, кожухи ремня, цепей и выхлопа, ремень безопасности. Зеркала и сигналы — не guards.

quiz.q: List 6 post-start checks that should be made after starting and before operating the forklift.
quiz.a_en: (1) Gauges and warning lights — all normal, no faults showing. (2) Horn works. (3) Lights, beacon and reversing alarm work. (4) Service brake and park brake hold. (5) Steering — full lock both ways, no excessive play. (6) All hydraulic functions — raise, lower, tilt forward/back, side shift, and check for leaks or abnormal noise.
quiz.a_ru: (1) Приборы и индикаторы. (2) Звуковой сигнал. (3) Свет, маячок, сигнал заднего хода. (4) Рабочий и стояночный тормоз. (5) Рулевое — полный поворот в обе стороны. (6) Все гидрофункции: подъём, опускание, наклон, боковое смещение; нет утечек и посторонних шумов.
key: Gauges and warning lights normal
Horn works
Lights, beacon, reversing alarm work
Service brake and park brake hold
Steering — full lock both ways
All hydraulics — raise, lower, tilt, side shift; no leaks or noise
options: Gauges and warning lights, horn, lights and alarm, service and park brakes, steering, all hydraulic functions
Tyre pressure, fork condition, data plate, fluid levels, seatbelt, overhead guard
Fuel level, odometer, engine temperature, oil pressure, battery voltage, hour meter
Only brakes and steering — the rest was done before starting
quiz.explain_ru: Post-start = после запуска: приборы, клаксон, свет и сигналы, тормоза, руль, гидравлика. Вариант B — это pre-start (до запуска).

quiz.q: Why is it important to communicate with workplace personnel before commencing work on site?
quiz.a_en: So that everyone knows what work is happening, where and when. It lets you identify site hazards, agree exclusion zones and traffic routes, coordinate with other plant and pedestrians, confirm site rules, permits and emergency procedures, and make sure nobody walks into your work area unexpectedly. Consultation is also a legal duty under WHS legislation.
quiz.a_ru: Чтобы все знали, какие работы идут, где и когда: выявить опасности площадки, согласовать зоны ограничения и маршруты движения, скоординироваться с другой техникой и пешеходами, уточнить правила, разрешения и аварийные процедуры. Консультация — ещё и требование закона WHS.
key: Everyone knows what work is happening, where and when
Identify site hazards, agree exclusion zones and traffic routes
Coordinate with other plant and pedestrians
Confirm site rules, permits, emergency procedures
Consultation is a legal duty under WHS
options: So everyone knows what work is happening, hazards and exclusion zones are agreed, other plant and pedestrians are coordinated, and the WHS duty to consult is met
To record who was on site in case of an insurance claim
Because the forklift cannot be started without a supervisor's PIN code
It is not required if the operator holds a current HRW licence
quiz.explain_ru: Коммуникация до начала работ: все знают, что происходит, выявлены опасности, согласованы зоны и маршруты. Плюс это требование закона WHS.

quiz.q: List 5 methods of communication that can be used in the workplace while operating your forklift.
quiz.a_en: (1) Verbal / face-to-face. (2) Two-way radio (UHF). (3) Standard hand signals. (4) The horn and reversing alarm. (5) Mobile phone. (Also: eye contact, whistle, signage, flashing beacon, written SWMS / job instructions.)
quiz.a_ru: (1) Устно, лицом к лицу. (2) Рация. (3) Стандартные жесты рук. (4) Клаксон и сигнал заднего хода. (5) Мобильный телефон. Также: зрительный контакт, свисток, знаки, маячок, письменные инструкции/SWMS.
key: Verbal / face-to-face
Two-way radio (UHF)
Standard hand signals
Horn and reversing alarm
Mobile phone
Also: eye contact, whistle, signage, beacon, written SWMS
options: Verbal, two-way radio, hand signals, horn and reversing alarm, mobile phone
Email, fax, noticeboard, company intranet, staff newsletter
Only the horn — any other communication distracts the operator
Shouting over the engine, flashing the headlights, revving the engine, texting, waving the load
quiz.explain_ru: Пять методов связи на площадке: устно, рация, жесты, клаксон/сигнал заднего хода, телефон. Email и доска объявлений — не для работы в движении.

quiz.q: If you are given unclear information about your work, what should you do?
quiz.a_en: Stop and do not start the task. Ask your supervisor to clarify and confirm the instruction before you proceed — never assume or guess. Get it in writing (SWMS, work order) if it is complex.
quiz.a_ru: Остановиться и не начинать работу. Уточнить у руководителя и получить подтверждение до начала — не догадываться. Если задача сложная — попросить письменную инструкцию (SWMS, наряд).
key: Stop — do not start the task
Ask your supervisor to clarify and confirm
Never assume or guess
Get it in writing (SWMS, work order) if complex
options: Stop, do not start the task, and ask your supervisor to clarify and confirm the instruction before proceeding
Use your experience to work out what was probably meant and get on with the job
Ask a co-worker what they would do and follow their advice
Start the task carefully and clarify the details during the first break
quiz.explain_ru: Неясная инструкция = остановиться и уточнить у руководителя. Не догадываться и не начинать «аккуратно».

quiz.q: Before commencing work who should you consult with?
quiz.a_en: Your supervisor or site manager; the principal contractor / client representative; other operators and site personnel working in or near the area; pedestrians and workers who may be affected; the Health and Safety Representative (HSR); and any spotter or dogman you will be working with.
quiz.a_ru: С руководителем/менеджером площадки; с генподрядчиком или представителем заказчика; с другими операторами и персоналом рядом; с пешеходами и работниками, которых это затронет; с представителем по охране труда (HSR); со стропальщиком/сигнальщиком, если он есть.
key: Supervisor / site manager
Principal contractor / client representative
Other operators and site personnel nearby
Pedestrians and workers who may be affected
Health and Safety Representative (HSR)
Spotter or dogman you will work with
options: Supervisor, site manager, other operators and site personnel, affected workers and pedestrians, the HSR, your spotter
Only the person who signed your timesheet
The forklift manufacturer's customer service line
Nobody — a licensed operator is responsible for their own safety only
quiz.explain_ru: Консультироваться нужно со всеми, кого касается работа: руководитель, другие операторы, пешеходы, HSR, сигнальщик.

quiz.q: Are you allowed to use a forklift that has a missing data plate?
quiz.a_en: No. Without the data plate you cannot know the rated capacity, load centre or attachment ratings, so the forklift must not be operated.
quiz.a_ru: Нет. Без таблички неизвестны грузоподъёмность, центр груза и параметры навесного оборудования — эксплуатация запрещена.
key: No
Without the data plate you cannot know rated capacity, load centre, attachment ratings
Must not be operated
options: No — without the data plate you cannot know the rated capacity or load centre, so the forklift must not be operated
Yes — if you have driven the same model before and remember its capacity
Yes — as long as you only lift light loads and keep the mast vertical
Yes — for up to one shift while a replacement plate is ordered
quiz.explain_ru: Без заводской таблички работать нельзя ни при каких условиях — неизвестна грузоподъёмность и load centre.

quiz.q: What action should you take if you find that the data plate is missing from the forklift?
quiz.a_en: Do not use the machine. Shut it down, remove the key, tag it 'Out of Service' / Danger tag and isolate it. Report it to your supervisor immediately and record it on the pre-start checklist. The forklift stays out of service until a correct replacement plate is obtained from the manufacturer and fitted.
quiz.a_ru: Не использовать. Заглушить, вынуть ключ, повесить бирку «Out of Service» и изолировать. Немедленно сообщить руководителю и записать в чек-лист. Машина не работает, пока производитель не выдаст и не установят новую табличку.
key: Do not use the machine
Shut down, remove key, tag Out of Service / Danger tag, isolate
Report to supervisor immediately, record on pre-start checklist
Stays out of service until the correct replacement plate is fitted
options: Do not use it: shut down, remove the key, tag it Out of Service, isolate it, report to your supervisor and record it on the checklist
Write the capacity on the mast with a marker pen and continue working
Operate at half the capacity you think it has until the plate is replaced
Finish the shift and mention it to the mechanic at the next service
quiz.explain_ru: Нет таблички: машина выводится из эксплуатации, ключ изъят, бирка Out of Service, доклад руководителю. Самодельные надписи не считаются.

quiz.q: What does hazard mean?
quiz.a_en: A hazard is any thing, situation, substance or activity that has the potential to cause harm — injury or illness to a person, or damage to plant, property or the environment.
quiz.a_ru: Опасность (hazard) — любой предмет, ситуация, вещество или действие, которое потенциально может причинить вред: травму или заболевание человеку, либо повреждение техники, имущества, среды.
key: Hazard = anything with the potential to cause harm
Thing, situation, substance or activity
Harm = injury or illness to a person, damage to plant, property, environment
options: Any thing, situation, substance or activity that has the potential to cause harm
The likelihood that harm will occur combined with how serious it would be
An injury that has already happened and been reported
A control measure used to protect pedestrians from mobile plant
quiz.explain_ru: HAZARD — то, что может причинить вред. Вариант B — определение RISK, не путать.

quiz.q: List 6 site hazards and 6 non-site hazards in the following table.
quiz.a_en: Site hazards are inside the work area and under your employer's control; 'other than site' hazards come from outside the boundary and you usually cannot control them. SITE: (1) Pedestrians and other workers on foot. (2) Other vehicles and mobile plant. (3) Uneven surfaces, potholes, ramps, slopes. (4) Overhead power lines, pipes and structures. (5) Stacked loads, racking, confined/restricted spaces. (6) Spills, poor lighting, noise, dust, exhaust fumes. NON-SITE: (1) Weather — rain, wind, storms, extreme heat. (2) Public traffic on adjacent roads. (3) Members of the public outside the site. (4) Adjacent worksites and neighbouring buildings. (5) Underground services outside the site. (6) Sun glare, wildlife, dust from outside.
quiz.a_ru: Опасности площадки — внутри рабочей зоны, под контролем работодателя; внешние приходят из-за периметра. НА ПЛОЩАДКЕ: (1) пешеходы и работники; (2) другая техника и транспорт; (3) неровности, ямы, рампы, уклоны; (4) ЛЭП, трубы и конструкции сверху; (5) штабеля, стеллажи, стеснённые пространства; (6) разливы, плохой свет, шум, пыль, выхлоп. ВНЕШНИЕ: (1) погода — дождь, ветер, гроза, жара; (2) общественный транспорт на соседних дорогах; (3) посторонние люди за периметром; (4) соседние стройки и здания; (5) подземные коммуникации за периметром; (6) блики солнца, животные, пыль извне.
key: SITE hazards — inside the work area, under employer's control
Pedestrians, other vehicles, uneven surfaces, overhead lines, racking, spills / poor lighting
NON-SITE hazards — from outside the boundary, usually not controllable
Weather, public traffic, members of the public, adjacent worksites, underground services outside, sun glare
options: Site: pedestrians, other plant, uneven surfaces, overhead lines, racking, spills. Non-site: weather, public traffic, members of the public, adjacent worksites, outside services, sun glare
Site: weather, public roads, neighbours. Non-site: pedestrians, racking, potholes
Site hazards are those found by the regulator; non-site hazards are found by the operator
There is no difference — all hazards are treated the same way
quiz.explain_ru: Site — внутри площадки и под контролем работодателя. Non-site — снаружи: погода, публичные дороги, соседние объекты.

quiz.q: What does risk mean?
quiz.a_en: Risk is the likelihood that a hazard will actually cause harm, combined with the consequence — how serious that harm would be. Risk assessment then decides what controls are needed.
quiz.a_ru: Риск — вероятность того, что опасность действительно причинит вред, в сочетании с тяжестью последствий. По оценке риска подбирают меры контроля.
key: Risk = likelihood that a hazard will cause harm
Combined with the consequence (how serious)
Risk assessment decides what controls are needed
options: The likelihood that a hazard will actually cause harm, combined with how serious that harm would be
Any thing or situation that has the potential to cause harm
The number of incidents recorded on site in the past year
A written procedure that tells you how to do a task safely
quiz.explain_ru: RISK — вероятность × тяжесть последствий. Вариант B — HAZARD; вариант D — SWMS.

quiz.q: What is the risk of refuelling while the engine is running?
quiz.a_en: Fire and explosion. Petrol/diesel vapour and LPG can be ignited by the hot engine, exhaust, electrical sparks or static. Always shut the engine down, remove the key, no smoking or naked flame, and refuel in a designated, well-ventilated area.
quiz.a_ru: Пожар и взрыв. Пары топлива или газ воспламеняются от горячего двигателя, выхлопа, искры или статики. Двигатель заглушить, ключ вынуть, не курить, заправляться в отведённом проветриваемом месте.
key: Fire and explosion
Fuel vapour / LPG ignited by hot engine, exhaust, sparks, static
Shut down, remove key, no smoking, designated ventilated area
options: Fire and explosion — fuel vapour or LPG can be ignited by the hot engine, exhaust, sparks or static
Fuel contamination because the pump runs backwards
Overfilling because the fuel gauge is not accurate while running
There is no risk — modern forklifts have sealed fuel systems
quiz.explain_ru: Заправка при работающем двигателе = пожар и взрыв. Двигатель глушим, ключ вынимаем, заправка только в отведённом месте.

quiz.q: Describe which way a loaded forklift should travel up a ramp and where your load should be facing.
quiz.a_en: Loaded: drive forward (up) the ramp and reverse down it — the load always faces up the slope. Keep the load low, mast tilted back, travel slowly and straight — never turn or travel across the slope. (Unloaded is the opposite: reverse up and drive forward down, so the forks point down the slope.)
quiz.a_ru: С грузом: вверх — передним ходом, вниз — задним ходом; груз всегда обращён вверх по склону. Груз низко, мачта отклонена назад, медленно и прямо — не поворачивать и не ехать поперёк склона. (Без груза наоборот: вверх задним ходом, вниз передним.)
key: LOADED: drive forward UP, reverse DOWN
Load always faces UP the slope
Load low, mast tilted back, slow and straight
Never turn or travel across a slope
Unloaded is the opposite: forks point DOWN the slope
options: Loaded: drive forward up and reverse down — the load always faces up the slope; keep it low and never turn on the ramp
Loaded: reverse up and drive forward down so you can see the ground ahead
Always drive forward in both directions — reversing on ramps is prohibited
Direction does not matter as long as the load is raised high enough to clear the ramp
quiz.explain_ru: С грузом: груз смотрит вверх по склону — вперёд вверх, задним ходом вниз. Без груза — наоборот, вилы вниз по склону.

quiz.q: What might occur if you attempt to turn a forklift while on a ramp or sloping surface?
quiz.a_en: You lose lateral (sideways) stability — the centre of gravity moves outside the stability triangle and the forklift can tip over sideways. The load can also slide or fall off the forks, and the machine can run away down the slope.
quiz.a_ru: Теряется боковая устойчивость: центр тяжести выходит за треугольник устойчивости и погрузчик может опрокинуться набок. Груз может соскользнуть с вил, машина — скатиться вниз.
key: Lose lateral (sideways) stability
Centre of gravity moves outside the stability triangle
Forklift tips over sideways
Load can slide or fall; machine can run away downhill
options: You lose sideways stability — the centre of gravity moves outside the stability triangle and the forklift can tip over
The engine stalls because the fuel pickup is uncovered
The hydraulics lock and the mast cannot be lowered
Nothing, if you turn slowly and keep the load raised for balance
quiz.explain_ru: Поворот на уклоне выводит центр тяжести из треугольника устойчивости → боковое опрокидывание.

quiz.q: How high should your load be raised when travelling?
quiz.a_en: Just clear of the ground — approximately 100–150 mm, with the mast tilted back to cradle the load. Low enough to keep the centre of gravity down and keep your vision clear, high enough to clear the ground conditions and any obstacles.
quiz.a_ru: Чуть выше земли — примерно 100–150 мм, мачта отклонена назад. Низко, чтобы центр тяжести был внизу и обзор не закрывался, но достаточно, чтобы не задевать неровности и препятствия.
key: Just clear of the ground — about 100–150 mm
Mast tilted back to cradle the load
Low centre of gravity, clear vision
High enough to clear ground conditions
options: Just clear of the ground — about 100–150 mm — with the mast tilted back
At eye level so you can watch the load at all times
About 1 metre, so it clears kerbs, pallets and other obstacles
As high as the mast allows, to keep the load away from pedestrians
quiz.explain_ru: 100–150 мм над землёй, мачта наклонена назад. Выше — растёт центр тяжести и перекрывается обзор.

quiz.q: When should hazard controls be applied?
quiz.a_en: As soon as a hazard is identified — before work starts, and again at any time during the work when conditions change or a new hazard appears. Controls are selected using the hierarchy of control (eliminate → substitute → isolate → engineering → administrative → PPE) and must be reviewed to confirm they are working.
quiz.a_ru: Сразу после выявления опасности — до начала работ и в любой момент, когда условия меняются или появляется новая опасность. Меры подбираются по иерархии контроля (устранить → заменить → изолировать → инженерные → организационные → СИЗ) и затем проверяются на эффективность.
key: As soon as a hazard is identified — before work starts
Again whenever conditions change or a new hazard appears
Hierarchy of control: eliminate → substitute → isolate → engineering → administrative → PPE
Review to confirm controls work
options: As soon as a hazard is identified — before work starts and again whenever conditions change — using the hierarchy of control
Only after an incident or near miss has been reported
At the end of the shift when the forklift is parked
Once a year during the site safety audit
quiz.explain_ru: Контроль опасностей применяется сразу при выявлении и повторно при любом изменении условий. Не после инцидента.

quiz.q: Why is it unsafe to operate a forklift with the load raised?
quiz.a_en: Raising the load raises the combined centre of gravity, which sharply reduces stability — the forklift can tip forward or sideways, especially when turning or on uneven ground. It also blocks your vision, and the raised load can strike overhead power lines, pipes, doorways or structures, or fall on someone.
quiz.a_ru: Подъём груза поднимает общий центр тяжести и резко снижает устойчивость — опрокидывание вперёд или набок, особенно в повороте и на неровностях. Плюс закрывается обзор, груз может задеть ЛЭП, трубы, проём или упасть на человека.
key: Raises the combined centre of gravity → sharply less stable
Can tip forward or sideways, especially turning or on uneven ground
Blocks your vision
Load can strike power lines, pipes, doorways, or fall on someone
options: It raises the centre of gravity and reduces stability, blocks vision, and the load can strike overhead structures or fall on someone
Because the hydraulic pump overheats when the mast is held up
It wears the lift chains faster than travelling with the load low
It is safe provided the forklift travels in reverse
quiz.explain_ru: Поднятый груз = высокий центр тяжести, плохая устойчивость, закрытый обзор, риск зацепить ЛЭП или уронить груз.

quiz.q: What should be provided for the gap between a truck and the loading dock before shifting the load?
quiz.a_en: A dock leveller, bridging plate or dock plate rated for the combined weight of the forklift and load, correctly positioned and secured so it cannot move. Before that: chock the truck wheels, apply the truck's park brake, and where required use wheel restraints or a trailer restraint system so the truck cannot roll away.
quiz.a_ru: Переходной мостик (dock leveller / bridge plate), рассчитанный на суммарный вес погрузчика и груза, правильно уложенный и закреплённый. До этого: подложить противооткатные упоры, включить стояночный тормоз грузовика, при необходимости — фиксаторы колёс/прицепа.
key: Dock leveller / bridging plate / dock plate rated for forklift + load
Correctly positioned and secured so it cannot move
Chock the truck wheels, apply truck park brake
Wheel restraints / trailer restraint system where required
options: A rated and secured dock plate or bridging plate, with the truck wheels chocked and its park brake applied
A couple of timber pallets laid flat across the gap
Nothing — a forklift can jump a gap up to 300 mm at low speed
A sheet of plywood held in place by the forklift's own weight
quiz.explain_ru: Между кузовом и доком — рассчитанная на вес мостовая плита, закреплённая; колёса грузовика под башмаками, стояночный тормоз включён.

quiz.q: A pallet contains an unbalanced load with one end heavier than the other — which end should be against the heel of the fork arms?
quiz.a_en: The heavy end goes against the heel of the forks, i.e. hard up against the load backrest and as close to the mast as possible. This keeps the load centre short and the centre of gravity back, which preserves capacity and stability.
quiz.a_ru: Тяжёлый конец — к пятке вил, вплотную к спинке каретки и как можно ближе к мачте. Так центр груза остаётся коротким, центр тяжести смещён назад — сохраняются грузоподъёмность и устойчивость.
key: Heavy end against the heel of the forks
Hard up against the load backrest, as close to the mast as possible
Keeps load centre short and centre of gravity back
Preserves capacity and stability
options: The heavy end — hard up against the load backrest, as close to the mast as possible
The light end — so the heavy end counterbalances the forklift at the tips
It makes no difference as long as the pallet is centred on the forks
The heavy end at the fork tips, with the mast tilted back to compensate
quiz.explain_ru: Тяжёлый конец — к пятке вил, к мачте. Так короче load centre и центр тяжести ближе к точке опоры.

quiz.q: If a pallet appears to be unsafely stacked, what would you do before lifting it?
quiz.a_en: Do not lift it. Stop, isolate or barricade the area so nobody is under or near it, and report it to your supervisor. The load must be re-stacked, re-strapped or shrink-wrapped and made safe by an authorised person before it is moved. Also inspect the pallet itself for damage.
quiz.a_ru: Не поднимать. Остановиться, оградить зону, чтобы никого рядом не было, сообщить руководителю. Груз должен быть переуложен/перевязан/обмотан и приведён в безопасное состояние уполномоченным лицом. Также проверить сам поддон на повреждения.
key: Do not lift it
Stop, isolate or barricade the area, report to supervisor
Load must be re-stacked, re-strapped or shrink-wrapped by an authorised person
Inspect the pallet itself for damage
options: Do not lift it — barricade the area, report it, and have the load re-stacked or secured by an authorised person before it is moved
Lift it slowly with the mast tilted fully back and travel at walking pace
Lift it a few centimetres to test whether it moves, then continue if it looks stable
Push the loose items back into place with the fork tips and then lift
quiz.explain_ru: Небезопасно уложенный паллет не поднимаем вообще. Зона ограждается, груз перекладывается уполномоченным лицом.

quiz.q: Why is rear end swing dangerous?
quiz.a_en: A counterbalance forklift steers with the rear wheels, so when you turn, the counterweight and rear of the machine swing out in a wide arc — much further than the driver expects. That swinging rear end can crush or strike pedestrians, other workers, racking, walls or plant standing close behind you, often out of your line of sight.
quiz.a_ru: Погрузчик управляется задними колёсами, поэтому в повороте противовес и корма выносятся по широкой дуге — заметно дальше, чем ожидает водитель. Этой кормой можно придавить или ударить пешехода, стеллаж, стену или технику сзади, часто вне поля зрения.
key: Counterbalance forklift steers with the REAR wheels
When turning, the counterweight swings out in a wide arc
Much further than the driver expects
Can crush pedestrians, strike racking, walls, plant — often out of sight
options: The forklift steers with its rear wheels, so the counterweight swings out in a wide arc when turning and can crush people or strike objects behind you
The rear tyres wear unevenly and the forklift loses traction
The counterweight can detach from the chassis during a sharp turn
It is only dangerous on electric forklifts because the battery is at the rear
quiz.explain_ru: Задний занос противовеса: рулят задние колёса, зад при повороте уходит далеко в сторону — это зона, которую оператор не видит.

quiz.q: What should you consider when stacking items on top of each other?
quiz.a_en: Weight distribution (heaviest and largest at the bottom, lightest on top); stability and interlocking of the stack; maximum safe stacking height and any site height limit; the floor or racking load rating; level, firm ground; uniform pallet size and condition; how the load is secured (strapping, wrapping); that the stack does not block lighting, sprinklers, exits or vision; and that you can safely retrieve it later.
quiz.a_ru: Распределение веса (тяжёлое и крупное — вниз); устойчивость и перевязка штабеля; предельная высота и лимиты площадки; несущая способность пола/стеллажа; ровное твёрдое основание; одинаковые исправные поддоны; фиксация груза (стяжки, стрейч); штабель не перекрывает свет, спринклеры, выходы, обзор; возможность безопасно снять его потом.
key: Heaviest and largest at the bottom, lightest on top
Stability and interlocking of the stack
Maximum safe stacking height and site limits
Floor or racking load rating
Level, firm ground; uniform pallet size
Secured — strapped, wrapped; not blocking lights, sprinklers, exits
options: Weight distribution (heaviest at the bottom), stack stability, height limits, floor and racking ratings, level ground, pallet condition, and that it does not block exits or sprinklers
Only the maximum height the mast can reach
Put the lightest items at the bottom so the stack is easier to pull apart later
Stack as high as possible to save floor space — stability is the racking's job
quiz.explain_ru: Штабелирование: тяжёлое вниз, лёгкое наверх, не выше лимита, ровный пол, рейтинг стеллажа, не загораживать выходы и спринклеры.

quiz.q: What is the minimum distance you should keep away from power lines?
quiz.a_en: For mobile plant operated by a person who is not a trained/authorised spotter, the usual exclusion distances are: 3 m for lines up to 132 kV, 6 m for 132–330 kV, and 8 m for above 330 kV. These distances vary between states and network operators — always confirm with the electricity asset owner and your state regulator, and follow the site SWMS.
quiz.a_ru: Для мобильной техники обычно: 3 м до линий до 132 кВ, 6 м для 132–330 кВ, 8 м свыше 330 кВ. Значения различаются по штатам и сетевым операторам — обязательно уточни у владельца сети и регулятора штата, следуй SWMS площадки.
key: 3 m — lines up to 132 kV
6 m — 132 kV to 330 kV
8 m — above 330 kV
Varies by state and network — confirm with the asset owner and the SWMS
options: 3 m up to 132 kV, 6 m for 132–330 kV, 8 m above 330 kV — and always confirm with the asset owner and your state regulator
1 m from any power line as long as the forks stay below the conductors
10 m from every power line regardless of voltage
There is no minimum — the overhead guard insulates the operator
quiz.explain_ru: 3 / 6 / 8 м по напряжению (до 132 кВ / 132–330 кВ / выше 330 кВ). Точные цифры — у владельца сети и регулятора штата.

quiz.q: What should you do if you have to work closer than the minimum distances required when working near power lines?
quiz.a_en: Do not proceed on your own judgement. You must contact the electricity supply authority / asset owner and obtain written permission or a permit. They may de-energise and earth the lines, fit insulating covers or tiger tails, or require a trained safety observer (spotter) in constant communication with you. A specific risk assessment and SWMS must be prepared, and everyone briefed before work starts.
quiz.a_ru: Самостоятельно решать нельзя. Нужно связаться с владельцем электросети и получить письменное разрешение/permit. Они могут обесточить и заземлить линию, установить изолирующие чехлы или tiger tails, потребовать обученного наблюдателя (spotter) на постоянной связи. Требуется отдельная оценка риска и SWMS с инструктажем всех участников.
key: Do not proceed on your own judgement
Contact the electricity supply authority / asset owner — written permission or permit
They may de-energise and earth, fit tiger tails, require a trained spotter
Specific risk assessment and SWMS, everyone briefed
options: Contact the electricity authority and obtain written permission — they may de-energise the line, fit covers or require a trained spotter; prepare a specific SWMS
Work quickly and keep the mast as low as possible while inside the zone
Use a rubber mat on the forks to insulate the load
Ask a co-worker to watch the gap and shout if you get too close
quiz.explain_ru: Ближе минимального расстояния — только с письменного разрешения владельца сети, с их мерами (отключение, tiger tails, обученный наблюдатель) и отдельным SWMS.

quiz.q: What is used to make power lines more visible? List 2.
quiz.a_en: (1) Tiger tails — brightly coloured line markers fitted over the conductors. (2) Aerial marker balls / spheres. (Also acceptable: goal posts and height-limit gantries, warning signs and flags, bunting, painted ground markings and a spotter.)
quiz.a_ru: (1) Tiger tails — яркие маркеры-«хвосты» на проводах. (2) Сигнальные шары на линии. (Также: «ворота»/ограничители высоты, предупреждающие знаки и флажки, разметка на земле, сигнальщик.)
key: Tiger tails — bright line markers over the conductors
Aerial marker balls / spheres
Also: goal posts, height gantries, warning signs, flags, bunting, spotter
options: Tiger tails and aerial marker balls
Reflective paint on the conductors and street lights
Insulating sleeves and rubber mats
A laser height indicator on the forklift mast
quiz.explain_ru: Два стандартных способа сделать ЛЭП заметнее: tiger tails (яркие накладки на провода) и шары-маркеры.

quiz.q: Do Tiger Tails insulate the power lines? Yes or no?
quiz.a_en: No. Tiger tails are a visual warning aid only — they do not insulate the conductor and give no protection from electrocution. The full exclusion distance still applies.
quiz.a_ru: Нет. Tiger tails — только визуальный маркер, они не изолируют провод и не защищают от поражения током. Безопасное расстояние соблюдается в полном объёме.
key: NO
Tiger tails are a visual warning aid only
No protection from electrocution
Full exclusion distance still applies
options: No — they are a visual warning only and give no protection; the full exclusion distance still applies
Yes — they are made of insulating rubber and allow work up to 1 m from the line
Yes — but only for lines up to 132 kV
Yes — if they are fitted by the electricity authority
quiz.explain_ru: Tiger tails НЕ изолируют. Это только визуальная метка; расстояния соблюдаются полностью.

quiz.q: How can you find out what voltages the overhead power lines are?
quiz.a_en: Contact the electricity supply authority / network asset owner that owns the line — they will confirm the voltage and the required exclusion zone in writing. Also check the site induction, the SWMS and risk assessment, site plans and any signage on the poles or towers. Never guess the voltage from the look of the line.
quiz.a_ru: Обратиться к владельцу электросети — он письменно подтвердит напряжение и требуемую зону ограничения. Также: инструктаж на площадке, SWMS и оценка риска, планы площадки, таблички на опорах. Определять напряжение «на глаз» нельзя.
key: Contact the electricity supply authority / asset owner — written confirmation
Check site induction, SWMS, risk assessment, site plans, pole signage
Never guess the voltage from the look of the line
options: Contact the electricity authority that owns the line; also check the site induction, SWMS and signage — never guess
Count the insulators on the pole — each one equals 11 kV
Judge by the thickness of the conductors and the height of the poles
Ask the site electrician to measure it with a multimeter
quiz.explain_ru: Напряжение подтверждает владелец сети письменно. Считать изоляторы и оценивать на глаз — нельзя.

quiz.q: What should you do if you drive into and make contact with power lines? List 6.
quiz.a_en: (1) Stay on the machine — do not step off, and do not touch the machine and the ground at the same time. (2) Warn everyone nearby to keep well clear and not to touch the forklift. (3) If it is safe, try to drive or break clear of the line in the direction you came from. (4) If you cannot break clear and you must get off (e.g. fire), jump clear with both feet together, never touching machine and ground together, and land upright. (5) Once on the ground, shuffle or bunny-hop with feet together in small steps for at least 10 m to avoid step potential. (6) Call emergency services and the electricity authority; keep everyone clear, and do not return to or touch the machine until the authority confirms the line is de-energised. Then report the incident and tag the machine out of service.
quiz.a_ru: (1) Оставаться на машине — не сходить, не касаться одновременно машины и земли. (2) Криком предупредить всех отойти и не трогать погрузчик. (3) Если безопасно — отъехать и разорвать контакт. (4) Если сойти всё же необходимо (например, пожар) — спрыгнуть, ноги вместе, не касаясь машины и земли одновременно, приземлиться на обе ноги. (5) На земле — мелкими шажками/прыжками, ноги вместе, минимум 10 м (шаговое напряжение). (6) Вызвать экстренные службы и энергокомпанию; никого не подпускать, не подходить к машине, пока линию не обесточат. Затем — рапорт об инциденте и бирка «не эксплуатировать».
key: STAY on the machine — do not touch machine and ground together
WARN everyone to keep clear and not touch the forklift
If safe, drive / break clear in the direction you came from
Must get off (fire)? JUMP clear, feet together, never touching both
SHUFFLE / bunny-hop with feet together at least 10 m (step potential)
CALL emergency services and the electricity authority; stay clear until confirmed de-energised; report and tag out
options: Stay on the machine, warn others to keep clear, try to break contact, jump clear with feet together only if you must, shuffle away 10 m, call emergency services and the authority
Switch off the engine, climb down normally and walk to the office to report it
Stay on the machine and wait — nobody else needs to be warned because the tyres insulate the forklift
Get off immediately and pull the line away from the mast with a timber pole
quiz.explain_ru: Контакт с ЛЭП: остаться на машине, предупредить людей, попытаться отъехать; покидать только прыжком со сведёнными ногами, потом шаркающими шагами 10 м; вызвать службы.

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: Why is it dangerous to operate internal combustion engines in restricted/confined spaces?
quiz.a_en: Exhaust gases build up — especially carbon monoxide (CO), which is colourless, odourless and can kill quickly, plus nitrogen oxides and diesel particulate. The engine also consumes oxygen, leading to oxygen depletion and asphyxiation. Heat and fuel vapour add a fire and explosion risk.
quiz.a_ru: Накапливаются выхлопные газы, прежде всего угарный газ (CO) — без цвета и запаха, убивает быстро; плюс оксиды азота и сажа. Двигатель расходует кислород → кислородное голодание и удушье. Добавляются жар и пары топлива — риск пожара и взрыва.
key: Exhaust gases build up — carbon monoxide (CO): colourless, odourless, kills quickly
Also nitrogen oxides and diesel particulate
Engine consumes oxygen → oxygen depletion, asphyxiation
Heat and fuel vapour → fire and explosion risk
options: Exhaust gases such as carbon monoxide build up and the engine uses up oxygen — people can be poisoned or asphyxiated
The engine overheats because there is not enough airflow over the radiator
The noise echoes and damages the operator's hearing
Diesel engines cannot be started without good airflow
quiz.explain_ru: В замкнутом пространстве ДВС накапливает угарный газ и сжигает кислород — отравление и удушье.

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: Why must batteries be charged in well ventilated areas?
quiz.a_en: Charging a lead-acid battery releases hydrogen gas, which is highly flammable and explosive in air and can be ignited by a single spark. Ventilation disperses the hydrogen and also removes corrosive acid mist. Keep all ignition sources away and follow the charging procedure.
quiz.a_ru: При заряде свинцово-кислотной батареи выделяется водород — крайне горюч и взрывоопасен, хватает одной искры. Вентиляция рассеивает водород и убирает кислотный туман. Источники воспламенения — прочь, процедуру заряда — соблюдать.
key: Charging a lead-acid battery releases HYDROGEN gas
Highly flammable and explosive — a single spark
Ventilation disperses hydrogen and acid mist
Keep ignition sources away, follow the charging procedure
options: Charging releases hydrogen gas, which is explosive — ventilation disperses it and the acid mist
The battery will not accept a charge in a warm, enclosed room
Batteries release carbon monoxide while charging
To keep the charger cool so it does not trip its circuit breaker
quiz.explain_ru: При заряде выделяется водород — взрывоопасен от одной искры. Только в проветриваемом месте, без источников воспламенения.

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: What would be a safer forklift to use in confined spaces?
quiz.a_en: An electric (battery-powered) forklift — it produces no exhaust emissions, is quieter and has no hot exhaust. Ventilation, atmospheric monitoring and a confined space permit may still be required.
quiz.a_ru: Электрический (аккумуляторный) погрузчик — нет выхлопа, тише, нет раскалённой выхлопной системы. Вентиляция, контроль атмосферы и разрешение на работу в замкнутом пространстве всё равно могут требоваться.
key: Electric (battery-powered) forklift
No exhaust emissions, quieter, no hot exhaust
Ventilation, atmospheric monitoring, confined space permit may still be required
options: An electric (battery-powered) forklift — it produces no exhaust emissions
An LPG forklift because gas burns cleaner than diesel
A diesel forklift with a taller exhaust stack
Any forklift, provided the engine is kept at idle
quiz.explain_ru: В замкнутых пространствах — электрический погрузчик: нет выхлопа. LPG тоже выделяет CO.

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: Why should you constantly monitor the load movement when operating the forklift?
quiz.a_en: So you detect any shifting, slipping, swinging or settling of the load immediately and can stop before it becomes unstable. Load movement changes the centre of gravity and can cause the load to fall onto people or plant, or tip the forklift. It also lets you keep the load clear of people, racking, structures and overhead services.
quiz.a_ru: Чтобы сразу заметить смещение, соскальзывание, раскачивание или проседание груза и остановиться до потери устойчивости. Движение груза меняет центр тяжести — груз может упасть на людей или технику, погрузчик — опрокинуться. Плюс контроль зазоров до людей, стеллажей, конструкций и коммуникаций.
key: Detect shifting, slipping, swinging or settling immediately
Stop before it becomes unstable
Load movement changes the centre of gravity → can fall or tip the forklift
Keep the load clear of people, racking, structures, overhead services
options: To detect any shifting or slipping immediately and stop before the load becomes unstable, falls or tips the forklift
Because the hour meter only counts when the load is moving
So you can estimate the weight of the load from how it sways
It is not necessary if the load is shrink-wrapped
quiz.explain_ru: Постоянно следить за грузом: любой сдвиг меняет центр тяжести — остановиться раньше, чем груз упадёт или машина опрокинется.

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: List 3 control measures you can apply for pedestrians, site personnel and vehicles or mobile equipment.
quiz.a_en: (1) Separation / exclusion zones — barricades, bollards, marked walkways, guardrails or overhead walkways that physically keep people away from forklift routes. (2) Traffic management plan — designated one-way routes, speed limits, give-way rules, signage, and a trained spotter at blind spots or crossings. (3) Awareness and PPE — site induction, high-visibility clothing, horn at intersections and doorways, flashing beacon and reversing alarm, eye contact before moving.
quiz.a_ru: (1) Разделение / зоны ограничения — ограждения, столбики, размеченные проходы, отбойники, надземные переходы. (2) План организации движения — маршруты, ограничение скорости, приоритеты, знаки, сигнальщик на слепых зонах и перекрёстках. (3) Осведомлённость и СИЗ — инструктаж, светоотражающая одежда, сигнал на перекрёстках и в проёмах, маячок и звук заднего хода, зрительный контакт перед началом движения.
key: Separation / exclusion zones — barricades, bollards, marked walkways, guardrails
Traffic management plan — one-way routes, speed limits, give-way rules, signage, spotter
Awareness and PPE — induction, hi-vis, horn at intersections, beacon, reversing alarm, eye contact
options: Physical separation (barricades, bollards, marked walkways), a traffic management plan (routes, speed limits, signage, spotter), and awareness/PPE (induction, hi-vis, horn, beacon)
Drive faster to spend less time near pedestrians
Rely on pedestrians to keep out of the way because they can see the forklift
Remove the horn and beacon so the noise does not startle people
quiz.explain_ru: Три меры: физическое разделение, план движения, осведомлённость + СИЗ (hi-vis, клаксон, маячок).

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: List the things that you should do in the event of steering, hydraulic or brake failure on a forklift.
quiz.a_en: • Stay calm, sound the horn to warn people and keep clear of pedestrians. • Bring the machine to a stop as safely as possible and lower the load to the ground if the hydraulics still allow it. • Apply the park brake and place controls in neutral. • Shut down the engine, isolate and remove the key. • Chock the wheels if you are on any slope. • Barricade or cordon off the area. • Tag and lock out the machine with an 'Out of Service' / Danger tag. • Report the failure to your supervisor immediately and record it. • Do not attempt repairs unless you are a competent, authorised person — the machine stays out of service until repaired and cleared.
quiz.a_ru: • Сохранять спокойствие, подать сигнал, увести машину от людей. • Остановиться максимально безопасно, опустить груз, если гидравлика ещё работает. • Стояночный тормоз, органы управления в нейтраль. • Заглушить, изолировать, вынуть ключ. • На уклоне — противооткатные упоры. • Оградить зону. • Повесить бирку «Out of Service» и заблокировать. • Немедленно доложить руководителю и записать. • Не ремонтировать самому, если ты не уполномоченный специалист — машина стоит до ремонта и допуска.
key: Stay calm, sound the horn, keep clear of pedestrians
Stop as safely as possible, lower the load if hydraulics allow
Park brake on, controls in neutral
Shut down, isolate, remove the key; chock wheels on a slope
Barricade the area; tag and lock out — Out of Service
Report to supervisor immediately; no repairs unless competent and authorised
options: Warn with the horn, stop as safely as possible, lower the load, park brake, shut down and remove the key, barricade, tag Out of Service, report
Continue slowly to the workshop so the mechanic can see the fault
Pump the brake pedal and keep working at reduced speed until the end of the shift
Switch the forklift off and on again to reset the fault, then continue
quiz.explain_ru: Отказ руля, гидравлики или тормозов: сигнал, безопасная остановка, груз на пол, стояночный тормоз, выключить, ключ, бирка, доклад. Не ехать в мастерскую.

quiz.section: Confined spaces, batteries and control measures
quiz.q: What must you have when working at night or in dark areas?
quiz.a_en: Adequate lighting: working headlights and work lamps on the forklift, a flashing amber beacon, and sufficient area/task lighting over the work zone and travel routes. Plus high-visibility reflective clothing for the operator and all pedestrians, clearly marked and lit walkways, and a risk assessment for reduced visibility (slower speeds, spotter where needed).
quiz.a_ru: Достаточное освещение: рабочие фары и лампы на погрузчике, проблесковый маячок, освещение рабочей зоны и маршрутов. Плюс светоотражающая одежда у оператора и пешеходов, размеченные и освещённые проходы, оценка риска для условий плохой видимости (меньше скорость, при необходимости сигнальщик).
key: Adequate lighting — headlights, work lamps, flashing amber beacon
Area/task lighting over the work zone and travel routes
High-visibility reflective clothing for operator and pedestrians
Marked and lit walkways; risk assessment — slower speeds, spotter
options: Adequate lighting (headlights, work lamps, beacon, area lighting), hi-vis reflective clothing, lit walkways and a risk assessment for reduced visibility
A torch in the cab and a co-worker walking ahead with a lamp
Night vision goggles supplied by the employer
Nothing extra — forklift headlights are sufficient for any site
quiz.explain_ru: Ночью и в темноте: достаточное освещение машины и зоны, светоотражающая одежда, подсвеченные дорожки, оценка риска.

quiz.q: What precautions can you take when operating on wet and slippery surfaces?
quiz.a_en: Reduce speed and allow a much greater stopping distance; brake, steer, accelerate and use the hydraulics smoothly with no sudden movements; keep the load low with the mast tilted back; avoid sharp turns and, where possible, ramps and slopes; check tyre condition and tread; clean up spills or use absorbent; keep the cab floor and your boots free of grease and mud; and if conditions are unsafe, stop work and report it.
quiz.a_ru: Снизить скорость и увеличить дистанцию торможения; тормозить, рулить, разгоняться и работать гидравликой плавно, без резких движений; груз низко, мачта назад; избегать резких поворотов и по возможности уклонов; проверить состояние шин; убрать разливы или засыпать сорбентом; следить, чтобы пол кабины и обувь были чистыми; если условия опасны — остановить работу и сообщить.
key: Reduce speed, allow much greater stopping distance
Brake, steer, accelerate, use hydraulics smoothly — no sudden movements
Load low, mast tilted back; avoid sharp turns, ramps, slopes
Check tyre tread; clean spills; keep boots and cab floor clean
If unsafe — stop work and report
options: Slow down, allow longer stopping distances, operate smoothly, keep the load low with the mast back, avoid sharp turns and slopes, check tyres and clean up spills
Travel faster so the tyres cut through the water film
Raise the load higher to put more weight on the drive wheels
Lock the steering straight ahead and only reverse on wet floors
quiz.explain_ru: Мокрая поверхность: медленнее, плавнее, больше дистанция, груз низко, без резких поворотов, шины и уборка разливов.

quiz.q: Why should you not raise or lower a load near or over people?
quiz.a_en: The load can slip, swing or fall and crush or kill anyone underneath or alongside. Hydraulic or chain failure can drop the load without warning, and people can be struck by the load, the forks or the mast, or trapped between the load and a structure. Nobody should ever be under or within the fall zone of a raised load.
quiz.a_ru: Груз может соскользнуть, качнуться или упасть и придавить/убить человека внизу или рядом. Отказ гидравлики или цепи роняет груз без предупреждения; людей может ударить грузом, вилами или мачтой, либо зажать между грузом и конструкцией. Под поднятым грузом и в зоне его падения не должно быть никого.
key: Load can slip, swing or fall — crush or kill anyone under or beside it
Hydraulic or chain failure drops the load without warning
People struck by load, forks or mast, or trapped against a structure
Nobody ever under or within the fall zone of a raised load
options: The load can slip or fall and crush anyone beneath it — hydraulic or chain failure can drop it without warning
Because the noise of the hydraulics is harmful to bystanders
It slows the job down while people move out of the way
It is acceptable if the people are wearing hard hats
quiz.explain_ru: Над людьми груз не поднимать и не опускать: может соскользнуть, упасть при отказе гидравлики или цепи. Каска не спасает.

quiz.q: Is it permissible to carry a load with one fork arm and why? List 2 reasons.
quiz.a_en: No. (1) The load would be unbalanced and unstable — the centre of gravity moves off the truck's centreline, cutting lateral stability and risking a sideways tip-over or the load falling off. (2) A single fork is not rated to carry the full load — each fork is designed for half the capacity, so it can bend, crack or break, and it damages the fork and voids the manufacturer's rating. Using one fork is also outside the manufacturer's instructions and therefore unlawful.
quiz.a_ru: Нет. (1) Груз несбалансирован и неустойчив — центр тяжести уходит с осевой линии, падает боковая устойчивость, риск опрокидывания набок и падения груза. (2) Одна вила не рассчитана на полный вес — каждая вила спроектирована на половину грузоподъёмности, она может согнуться, треснуть или сломаться; это повреждает вилу и аннулирует расчётные параметры. Такая работа противоречит инструкции производителя и потому недопустима.
key: NO
Unbalanced and unstable — centre of gravity off the centreline → sideways tip-over or load falls
One fork is not rated for the full load — each fork carries half → bends, cracks, breaks
Outside manufacturer's instructions = unlawful
options: No — the load is unbalanced and the centre of gravity moves off-centre, and a single fork is only rated for half the capacity and may bend or break
Yes — if the load is less than half the rated capacity
Yes — for short distances at walking pace with the mast tilted back
Yes — provided a spotter walks beside the load
quiz.explain_ru: Одной вилой нельзя: (1) груз неустойчив, центр тяжести уходит вбок; (2) вила рассчитана на половину груза и может сломаться.

quiz.q: Is it permissible to carry passengers on a forklift and why?
quiz.a_en: No. A forklift is designed for one operator only — there is no second seat, seatbelt or restraint, and no protection outside the operator's compartment. A passenger can fall off, be thrown out in a tip-over and crushed by the overhead guard, be struck by the mast or counterweight, or interfere with the controls. The only exception is a purpose-built, approved and securely attached work platform (man cage) used to lift people under a documented safe work procedure — never for travelling.
quiz.a_ru: Нет. Погрузчик рассчитан на одного оператора: нет второго сиденья, ремня и защиты вне кабины. Пассажир может выпасть, при опрокидывании быть выброшенным и придавленным крышей, получить удар мачтой или противовесом, помешать управлению. Единственное исключение — сертифицированная надёжно закреплённая рабочая платформа (man cage) для подъёма людей по утверждённой процедуре, но не для перевозки.
key: NO
One operator only — no second seat, seatbelt or restraint
Passenger can fall, be thrown out and crushed by the overhead guard, interfere with controls
Only exception: approved, secured work platform (man cage) under a safe work procedure — never for travelling
options: No — there is no seat or restraint for a passenger; the only exception is an approved, securely attached work platform used under a documented procedure
Yes — a passenger may stand on the forks if they hold the mast
Yes — a trainee may ride on the counterweight to learn the job
Yes — if the passenger holds a HRW licence too
quiz.explain_ru: Пассажиров возить нельзя. Единственное исключение — одобренная рабочая платформа (man cage) по процедуре, и только для подъёма, не для перемещения.

quiz.q: How does increasing the load centre affect the capacity of the forklift?
quiz.a_en: Increasing the load centre distance reduces the safe working capacity — the further the centre of the load sits from the heel of the forks, the greater the leverage about the fulcrum (front axle), so the machine can safely lift less. Capacity falls roughly in inverse proportion: a forklift rated 4200 kg at 600 mm can only lift about 3600 kg at 700 mm and about 2520 kg at 1000 mm. Always read the actual figures off the data plate, never estimate.
quiz.a_ru: Увеличение расстояния до центра груза снижает безопасную грузоподъёмность: чем дальше центр груза от пятки вил, тем больше плечо относительно точки опоры (передней оси), и тем меньше можно поднять. Зависимость примерно обратно пропорциональная: 4200 кг при 600 мм → около 3600 кг при 700 мм и около 2520 кг при 1000 мм. Реальные значения — только по табличке, не «на глаз».
key: Increasing load centre REDUCES capacity
Further from the heel of the forks = more leverage about the fulcrum (front axle)
Roughly inverse proportion: 4200 kg @ 600 mm ≈ 3600 kg @ 700 mm ≈ 2520 kg @ 1000 mm
Always read the data plate — never estimate
options: It reduces the safe working capacity — the further out the load centre, the more leverage about the front axle, so the forklift can lift less
It increases capacity because the load is spread over more of the fork length
It has no effect — capacity depends only on the engine power
It only matters for loads heavier than 5000 kg
quiz.explain_ru: Чем дальше центр груза от пятки вил — тем больше рычаг и меньше грузоподъёмность. 4200 кг @ 600 мм → ~3600 кг @ 700 мм.

quiz.q: What can happen if the load is not hard up against the heel of the fork arms?
quiz.a_en: The load centre distance increases, so the actual capacity of the forklift drops and you may unknowingly overload it. The centre of gravity shifts forward and can move outside the stability triangle, causing a forward tip-over. The load can also slide forward off the forks, and the fork arms are stressed at the wrong point and may bend or crack.
quiz.a_ru: Растёт расстояние до центра груза, фактическая грузоподъёмность падает — можно незаметно перегрузить машину. Центр тяжести смещается вперёд и может выйти за треугольник устойчивости → опрокидывание вперёд. Груз может соскользнуть с вил, а сами вилы нагружаются не в той точке и могут погнуться или треснуть.
key: Load centre distance increases → actual capacity drops → unknowing overload
Centre of gravity shifts forward, can leave the stability triangle → forward tip-over
Load can slide forward off the forks
Fork arms stressed at the wrong point — bend or crack
options: The load centre increases, capacity drops and you may overload it; the centre of gravity moves forward and the forklift can tip forwards or the load slide off
The mast will tilt forward automatically to compensate
Nothing — the fork tips are the strongest part of the fork arm
The forklift becomes more stable because the weight is further from the counterweight
quiz.explain_ru: Груз не у пятки вил = длиннее load centre, меньше капасити, центр тяжести вперёд — опрокидывание вперёд или груз соскальзывает.

quiz.q: Are you allowed to add additional counterweights without referring to the manufacturer?
quiz.a_en: No — never. Adding counterweight changes the design stability, overloads the axles, tyres, chassis and mast, and invalidates the data plate and the manufacturer's rating. It requires written approval from the manufacturer or a competent engineer, with a new capacity data plate fitted. Doing it without that is unsafe and unlawful.
quiz.a_ru: Нет, никогда. Добавление противовеса меняет расчётную устойчивость, перегружает оси, шины, раму и мачту, делает недействительными табличку и заводские параметры. Нужно письменное согласование производителя или компетентного инженера и новая табличка грузоподъёмности. Без этого — небезопасно и незаконно.
key: NO — never
Changes design stability; overloads axles, tyres, chassis, mast
Invalidates the data plate and manufacturer's rating
Needs written approval from manufacturer / competent engineer and a new data plate
options: No — it changes the design stability, overloads the axles and mast, and invalidates the data plate; written approval and a new plate are required
Yes — provided the extra weight is bolted on securely
Yes — up to 10 % of the rated capacity
Yes — if the forklift is only used indoors
quiz.explain_ru: Добавлять противовес самостоятельно нельзя: меняется устойчивость, перегружаются оси, табличка теряет силу. Только с письменного одобрения производителя.

quiz.q: How could you determine the weight of a load?
quiz.a_en: Check the documentation and markings — delivery docket, manifest, packing list, shipping label or the weight stencilled on the load itself; ask the supervisor, consignor or manufacturer; weigh it on a weighbridge, platform scales or with a load-weighing attachment/indicator fitted to the forklift; or calculate it from the material's density and volume. Never lift a load of unknown weight.
quiz.a_ru: Проверить документы и маркировку — накладную, манифест, упаковочный лист, ярлык или вес, нанесённый на сам груз; спросить руководителя, отправителя или производителя; взвесить на весовой платформе, весах или через навесной динамометр/весы на погрузчике; либо рассчитать по плотности материала и объёму. Груз неизвестного веса поднимать нельзя.
key: Documentation and markings — delivery docket, manifest, packing list, shipping label, stencilled weight
Ask the supervisor, consignor or manufacturer
Weigh it — weighbridge, platform scales, load-weighing attachment
Calculate from density × volume
Never lift a load of unknown weight
options: Check the docket, manifest or markings; ask the supervisor or consignor; weigh it on scales or a weighing attachment; or calculate it from density and volume
Lift it and see whether the rear wheels come off the ground
Estimate it by comparing it with the last load you carried
Assume it is within capacity if it fits on a standard pallet
quiz.explain_ru: Вес груза узнаём из документов и маркировки, у ответственного, взвешиванием или расчётом. «Приподнять и посмотреть» — нет.

quiz.q: What should you do if a forklift is tipping over?
quiz.a_en: Do not jump. Stay in the seat with the seatbelt on, grip the steering wheel firmly, brace your feet, and lean away from the direction of the fall — this keeps you inside the protective zone of the overhead guard. Operators who jump are usually crushed by the overhead guard as it comes down. Once it has stopped moving, shut down, get out safely, and report the incident.
quiz.a_ru: Не прыгать. Оставаться в кресле пристёгнутым, крепко держать руль, упереться ногами и отклониться в сторону, противоположную падению — так остаёшься в защитной зоне под крышей. Тех, кто прыгает, обычно придавливает опускающейся защитной крышей. После остановки — заглушить, безопасно выйти, доложить об инциденте.
key: DO NOT JUMP
Stay in the seat with the seatbelt on
Grip the steering wheel, brace your feet
Lean AWAY from the direction of the fall
Jumping = crushed by the overhead guard
options: Do not jump — stay in the seat with the seatbelt on, grip the wheel, brace your feet and lean away from the direction of the fall
Jump clear on the side the forklift is falling towards so you land first
Unbuckle the seatbelt and jump out of the opposite side
Stand up on the seat and hold the overhead guard
quiz.explain_ru: При опрокидывании НЕ прыгать: остаться в кресле, ремень, держаться за руль, отклониться от направления падения. Прыгнувших давит защитная крыша.

quiz.q: Look at the following, which load is within the capacity of the forklift rated at 4200 kg at 600 mm?
quiz.a_en: Answer: B. The load centre is measured from the face/heel of the forks to the centre of the load — for a uniform load that is half its length. A = 1400 mm ÷ 2 = 700 mm (beyond the rated 600 mm — capacity drops to about 3600 kg, so 4200 kg is an overload). B = 1000 mm ÷ 2 = 500 mm (inside the rated 600 mm — capacity is about 5040 kg, so 4200 kg is safe). C = 1300 mm ÷ 2 = 650 mm (beyond 600 mm — capacity about 3877 kg, so 4200 kg is an overload). Only B is within capacity.
quiz.a_ru: Ответ: B. Центр груза меряется от пятки вил до середины груза — для равномерного груза это половина его длины. A = 1400 ÷ 2 = 700 мм (больше 600 → доступно ≈3600 кг, значит 4200 кг — перегруз). B = 1000 ÷ 2 = 500 мм (меньше 600 → ≈5040 кг, 4200 кг безопасно). C = 1300 ÷ 2 = 650 мм (больше 600 → ≈3877 кг, перегруз). В пределах грузоподъёмности только B.
key: Answer: B
Load centre = half the length of a uniform load, measured from the heel of the forks
A: 1400 ÷ 2 = 700 mm → beyond 600 → overload
B: 1000 ÷ 2 = 500 mm → inside 600 → SAFE
C: 1300 ÷ 2 = 650 mm → beyond 600 → overload
options: B — a 1000 mm long load has a 500 mm load centre, inside the rated 600 mm
A — a 1400 mm long load has a 700 mm load centre
C — a 1300 mm long load has a 650 mm load centre
All three, because each weighs exactly 4200 kg
quiz.explain_ru: Load centre = половина длины однородного груза. Только у B (500 мм) он не превышает номинальные 600 мм, значит 4200 кг — в пределах.

quiz.q: List 5 causes of tipping a forklift sideways.
quiz.a_en: a) Turning too fast or too sharply, especially with the load raised. b) Turning on a ramp, slope or crossfall, or travelling across a slope. c) Uneven, soft or damaged ground — potholes, kerbs, trench grates, edges of docks. d) An off-centre or unbalanced load, or a side shift attachment not centralised. e) Travelling with the load raised too high, which lifts the centre of gravity out of the stability triangle. (Also: striking an obstacle, over-inflated/damaged or mismatched tyres, sudden steering correction, wind on a high load.)
quiz.a_ru: a) Слишком быстрый или резкий поворот, особенно с поднятым грузом. b) Поворот на рампе/уклоне или движение поперёк склона. c) Неровный, мягкий или разбитый грунт — ямы, бордюры, решётки, край рампы. d) Груз смещён от оси или боковое смещение не отцентрировано. e) Движение со слишком высоко поднятым грузом — центр тяжести выходит за треугольник устойчивости. (Также: наезд на препятствие, неисправные или разные шины, резкий доворот руля, ветер на высоком грузе.)
key: Turning too fast or too sharply, especially with the load raised
Turning on a ramp or slope, or travelling across a slope
Uneven, soft or damaged ground — potholes, kerbs, dock edges
Off-centre or unbalanced load; side shift not centralised
Travelling with the load raised too high
options: Turning too fast or sharply, turning on a slope, uneven or soft ground, an off-centre load, travelling with the load raised
Overloading, load centre too far forward, braking hard, tilting the mast forward, driving down a slope with the load first
Low tyre pressure on the rear wheels only
Travelling in reverse with the forks lowered
quiz.explain_ru: Боковое опрокидывание: быстрый/резкий поворот, поворот на уклоне, плохой грунт, смещённый груз, высоко поднятый груз. Вариант B — причины опрокидывания вперёд.

quiz.q: List 5 causes of tipping a forklift forwards.
quiz.a_en: a) Overloading — lifting more than the rated capacity on the data plate. b) Load centre too far forward — the load is not hard up against the heel of the forks, or is longer than the rated load centre. c) Braking too hard while travelling forward with a load, or hitting an obstacle. d) Tilting the mast forward with the load raised, or lowering the load too fast. e) Driving down a slope with the load facing downhill instead of reversing down. (Also: sudden acceleration in reverse, dropping into a pothole, lifting with the mast tilted forward.)
quiz.a_ru: a) Перегруз — больше номинала на табличке. b) Центр груза слишком далеко вперёд — груз не прижат к пятке вил или длиннее расчётного. c) Резкое торможение при движении вперёд с грузом или наезд на препятствие. d) Наклон мачты вперёд с поднятым грузом или слишком быстрое опускание. e) Спуск с уклона грузом вниз вместо движения задним ходом. (Также: резкий разгон назад, провал в яму, подъём с наклонённой вперёд мачтой.)
key: Overloading — more than the rated capacity
Load centre too far forward — not against the heel, or longer than rated
Braking too hard travelling forward with a load, or hitting an obstacle
Tilting the mast forward with the load raised; lowering too fast
Driving down a slope with the load facing downhill
options: Overloading, load centre too far forward, braking hard with a load, tilting the mast forward with the load raised, driving down a slope with the load first
Turning too fast, turning on a slope, uneven ground, an off-centre load, travelling with the load raised
Reversing up a ramp with an empty forklift
Centralising the side shift before travelling
quiz.explain_ru: Опрокидывание вперёд: перегруз, длинный load centre, резкое торможение с грузом, наклон мачты вперёд с поднятым грузом, спуск грузом вниз. Вариант B — боковое.

quiz.section: Attachments, parking and duty of care
quiz.q: Why should a side shift attachment be centralised before travelling with a load?
quiz.a_en: Because an off-centre load moves the combined centre of gravity sideways, away from the truck's centreline and towards the edge of the stability triangle. That reduces lateral stability and the rated capacity, and makes a sideways tip-over much more likely — particularly when turning, braking or on uneven ground. Centralising also gives you predictable steering and better vision.
quiz.a_ru: Смещённый в сторону груз уводит общий центр тяжести от осевой линии к краю треугольника устойчивости. Падают боковая устойчивость и фактическая грузоподъёмность, резко растёт риск опрокидывания набок — особенно в повороте, при торможении и на неровностях. Центровка также даёт предсказуемое управление и лучший обзор.
key: Off-centre load moves the combined centre of gravity sideways
Towards the edge of the stability triangle
Less lateral stability and less capacity → sideways tip-over
Especially when turning, braking, uneven ground; also predictable steering and vision
options: An off-centre load moves the centre of gravity sideways towards the edge of the stability triangle, reducing lateral stability and capacity
Because the side shift hydraulics leak if left extended
So the forks line up with the pallet pockets at the next stop
It is not necessary if the load is lighter than half the rated capacity
quiz.explain_ru: Side shift в центр перед движением: смещённый груз сдвигает центр тяжести к краю треугольника устойчивости — боковое опрокидывание.

quiz.section: Attachments, parking and duty of care
quiz.q: Why should you wear a seatbelt?
quiz.a_en: It keeps you inside the operator's protective zone during a tip-over or collision. Without it you are thrown out of the seat and typically crushed between the ground and the overhead guard — the most common cause of forklift fatalities. It also stops you being thrown against the controls or out of the machine over rough ground. Wearing it is a legal requirement where one is fitted.
quiz.a_ru: Ремень удерживает в защитной зоне при опрокидывании или столкновении. Без него оператора выбрасывает из кресла и, как правило, придавливает между землёй и защитной крышей — самая частая причина гибели на погрузчиках. Также ремень не даёт удариться об органы управления или вылететь на неровностях. Если ремень установлен, его использование обязательно по закону.

quiz.q: Why should you remove the keys from a forklift after use?
quiz.a_en: To prevent unauthorised, untrained or unlicensed people from starting and operating it, to prevent accidental or unintentional start-up, and to stop theft or vandalism. Keys should be secured and only issued to licensed operators.

quiz.q: What is your duty of care as a HRW operator?
quiz.a_en: Under WHS legislation you must take reasonable care for your own health and safety and for the health and safety of anyone affected by your work. In practice: only operate plant you are licensed, trained and authorised for; comply with reasonable instructions, site rules, SWMS and procedures; carry out pre-start checks and not use faulty plant; wear the required PPE; report hazards, incidents, near misses and damage; never work under the influence of alcohol or drugs; and do nothing that puts yourself or others at risk.
quiz.a_ru: По законодательству WHS обязан разумно заботиться о собственной безопасности и о безопасности всех, кого затрагивает твоя работа. quiz.section: Attachments, parking and duty of care
quiz.q: How can a HRW operator be penalised if they fail to operate the forklift safely?
quiz.a_en: Through on-the-spot fines and infringement notices issued by the WHS regulator; prosecution under the WHS Act with substantial fines and, for the most serious categories (reckless conduct / industrial manslaughter), imprisonment; suspension or cancellation of the High Risk Work licence, and refusal of a future licence; plus employer action — retraining, removal from the task, disciplinary action or dismissal, and possible civil liability.

quiz.section: Attachments, parking and duty of care
quiz.q: If you're driving with a large load where your view is obstructed, what should you do?
quiz.a_en: Travel in reverse, with the load trailing, so you have a clear view in the direction of travel — the exception is travelling up or down a ramp, where the load must stay facing up the slope. Also: use a trained spotter to guide you, sound the horn at intersections and doorways, travel slowly, keep the load low, use mirrors and always look in the direction you are travelling. If the view still cannot be made safe, stop and split the load or find another method.
quiz.a_ru: Ехать задним ходом, грузом назад, чтобы видеть направление движения — исключение — рампа, там груз всегда обращён вверх по склону. Также: работать с обученным сигнальщиком, подавать сигнал на перекрёстках и в проёмах, ехать медленно, держать груз низко, использовать зеркала и всегда смотреть в направлении движения. Если обзор всё равно небезопасен — остановиться, разделить груз или выбрать другой способ.

(2) Strong winds and sudden gusts (especially with high or large-surface loads). (3) Storms, thunder and lightning. (4) Fog, smoke, dust storms or heavy rain reducing visibility. (5) Экстремальная жара (тепловой стресс, шины, гидравлика) либо мороз, лёд, иней, снег. (6) Подтопление, грязь или вода, скрывающая ямы и коммуникации. (Также: слепящее низкое солнце, пыль и газы от соседних работ.) 63. List at least 2 things that your employer needs to provide you prior to undertaking work on an unfamiliar forklift. (2) Руководство производителя и данные заводской таблички. (Также: инструктаж и правила площадки, SWMS/оценка риска на задачу, чек-лист предпусковой проверки, журнал ТО, необходимые СИЗ.) 64. How does the jib attachment affect your forklift? It substantially reduces the rated capacity. The jib adds its own weight out in front of the fulcrum and moves the load centre a long way forward, so the safe working load falls sharply and decreases further as the jib is extended. It also raises the centre of gravity, reduces forward and lateral stability, and introduces a freely suspended, swinging load that can shift the centre of gravity dynamically. The forklift must have a separate data plate for the jib showing the de-rated capacity at each jib position, the hooks' SWL must be known, and travel must be slow with the load as low as possible. Он существенно снижает грузоподъёмность: стрела добавляет собственный вес впереди точки опоры и сильно выносит центр груза вперёд, поэтому допустимая нагрузка резко падает и уменьшается ещё сильнее при выдвижении стрелы. Также поднимается центр тяжести, падает продольная и боковая устойчивость, а свободно подвешенный раскачивающийся груз динамически смещает центр тяжести. На погрузчике должна быть отдельная табличка для стрелы со сниженной грузоподъёмностью для каждого положения, нужно знать SWL крюков, двигаться медленно и держать груз максимально низко. 65. What is the most common load centre in mm? 600 mm. 600 мм. 66. How does obtaining the weather forecast help you? It lets you plan and risk-assess before you start: decide whether the work can be done safely at all, reschedule or stop work for high wind, storms or heavy rain, choose safe routes and firm ground, secure or shrink-wrap loads, arrange extra controls (lighting, drainage, wet-weather PPE, additional spotters), allow for heat stress breaks and hydration, protect stored materials, and warn other workers. In short — it turns an unplanned hazard into a planned, controlled one. Позволяет спланировать работу и оценить риски заранее: решить, можно ли вообще работать безопасно, перенести или остановить работы при сильном ветре, грозе или ливне, выбрать безопасные маршруты и твёрдый грунт, закрепить или упаковать груз, добавить меры (освещение, водоотвод, СИЗ для дождя, дополнительные сигнальщики), предусмотреть перерывы и питьё в жару, защитить складированные материалы, предупредить коллег. Иначе говоря — превращает внезапную опасность в спланированную и контролируемую. quiz.q: Name the 8 forklift attachments and the matching safety consideration for each. (K.E.13)
quiz.a_en: (1) Rotator / fork rotator — ensure you have sufficient ground clearance when rotating. (2) Drum handler / drum grab — access and read the SDS before attempting to lift. (3) Carpet pole / roll prong — the forklift should be driven backwards. (4) Jib / crane arm with hooks — identify the SWL of the hooks. (5) Roll clamp / bale clamp — can be used to lift paper rolls. (6) Work platform / man cage — the driver must remain in the forklift operator's seat. (7) Fork extensions / fork slippers — must never be more than 1.5 times the length of the original forks. (8) Brick / block clamp — plan your path for sufficient turning space. Every attachment must be approved for that forklift, fitted per the manufacturer, and the forklift needs a de-rated capacity data plate for it.
