quiz.section: Weather, unfamiliar plant and ground conditions
quiz.q: How does the jib attachment affect your forklift?
quiz.a_en: It substantially reduces the rated capacity. The jib adds its own weight out in front of the fulcrum and moves the load centre a long way forward, so the safe working load falls sharply and decreases further as the jib is extended. It also raises the centre of gravity, reduces forward and lateral stability, and introduces a freely suspended, swinging load that can shift the centre of gravity dynamically. The forklift must have a separate data plate for the jib showing the de-rated capacity at each jib position, the hooks' SWL must be known, and travel must be slow with the load as low as possible.
quiz.a_ru: Существенно снижает грузоподъёмность: стрела добавляет свой вес впереди точки опоры и выносит центр груза вперёд; нагрузка резко падает и уменьшается ещё сильнее при выдвижении стрелы. Поднимается центр тяжести, падает продольная и боковая устойчивость, подвешенный груз раскачивается и динамически смещает центр тяжести. Нужна отдельная табличка со сниженной грузоподъёмностью для каждого положения стрелы, знать SWL крюков, двигаться медленно и держать груз низко.

quiz.section: Weather, unfamiliar plant and ground conditions
quiz.q: Tick nine (9) surface/ground conditions that may affect safe operation and stability. (K.E.19)
quiz.a_en: TICK (unsafe): (1) Backfilled ground — may collapse or subside under the wheels. (2) Potholes — sudden drop, load shift and tipping. (3) Damaged cracked bitumen — breaks up under load, uneven wheel support. (4) Railway tracks — raised rails and gaps jolt the machine and load. (5) Damaged cracked concrete — can break away, especially at edges. (6) Rough uneven surface — constant jolting, load instability. (7) Soft soil — wheels sink, machine leans. (8) Sloping surface — reduces stability; never turn across a slope. (9) Trench covers / grates — may not be rated for forklift + load weight. DO NOT TICK (suitable): hard compacted soil, firm level site, smooth concrete floor slab.
quiz.a_ru: ОТМЕТИТЬ (опасные): (1) подсыпанный/обратно засыпанный грунт — может просесть; (2) ямы — провал колеса, смещение груза; (3) разбитый асфальт — крошится, неровная опора; (4) ж/д пути — толчки на рельсах и зазорах; (5) треснувший бетон — обламывается у краёв; (6) неровная поверхность — тряска, груз теряет устойчивость; (7) мягкий грунт — колёса проваливаются, крен; (8) уклон — снижает устойчивость, поперёк склона не поворачивать; (9) люки и решётки траншей — могут быть не рассчитаны на вес погрузчика с грузом. НЕ отмечать (пригодные): плотный утрамбованный грунт, ровная твёрдая площадка, гладкий бетонный пол.

Walk 3 m away using normal steps
Climb down using the metal frame, then walk away
mc.explain_ru: Нужно уйти прыжками/шаркая на 8 м, держа ступни вместе — иначе шаговое напряжение пропустит ток через тело. Металла касаться нельзя.
mc.source: Разд. 3, шаг 3: jump/shuffle 8m, feet together

mc.q: Which type of forklift is most suitable in a confined space with limited air flow?
options: An LPG forklift
An all terrain forklift
A diesel forklift
An electric forklift
mc.explain_ru: В замкнутом пространстве с ограниченным воздухообменом подходит только электрический погрузчик — у него нет выхлопа.
mc.source: Разд. 4: Which forklift in a confined space? An electric forklift

mc.q: Why is an internal combustion forklift unsuitable where there is limited air flow?
options: It is too heavy for indoor floors
It has a higher centre of gravity
Its tyres mark the concrete
Fumes can kill you
mc.explain_ru: Точная формулировка курса: Fumes can kill you — выхлопные газы убивают.
mc.source: Разд. 4: Why is an IC forklift unsuitable indoors? Fumes can kill you

mc.q: Why does an all terrain forklift tip over more easily?
options: Due to having solid tyres
Due to having a higher centre of gravity
Due to having a shorter wheelbase
Due to having no counterweight
mc.explain_ru: All terrain погрузчик легче опрокидывается due to having a higher centre of gravity — выше центр тяжести.
mc.source: Разд. 4: Why do all-terrain forklifts tip? Due to having a higher centre of gravity

mc.q: When a forklift turns, approximately how fast does the rear end swing out compared with the speed of the forklift?
options: About twice the speed of the forklift
About half the speed of the forklift
At the same speed as the forklift
About three times the speed of the forklift
mc.explain_ru: Rear end swing: задняя часть уходит вбок примерно в три раза быстрее скорости самого погрузчика; опасность — could hit nearby people or objects.
mc.source: Разд. 5: задняя часть уходит вбок со скоростью примерно в три раза выше (x3)

mc.q: Which set of precautions applies when the surface becomes wet or slippery?
options: Speed up, brake hard, turn sharply, use ramps only
Lower the tyre pressure, brake slowly, use a spotter, sound the horn
Slow down, brake slowly, turn slowly, avoid using ramps/slopes
Slow down, brake hard, turn slowly, raise the load higher
mc.explain_ru: Четыре обязательные меры на мокрой/скользкой поверхности: Slow down, Brake slowly, Turn slowly, Avoid using ramps / slopes.
mc.source: Разд. 4: Slow down / Brake slowly / Turn slowly / Avoid using ramps

mc.q: Most forklifts are designed for hard bitumen or flat concrete. Which surface should always be avoided?
options: Hard smooth bitumen in good condition
Flat sealed concrete
A level warehouse floor
Backfilled ground
mc.explain_ru: Список поверхностей, которых нужно избегать: backfilled ground, damaged cracked concrete, trench covers or grates, soft soils, railway tracks, potholes, rough uneven surfaces, damaged cracked bitumen, sloping surfaces.
mc.source: Разд. 17: Backfilled ground — в списке поверхностей, которых следует избегать

mc.q: Why must a battery on charge always be in a ventilated area?
options: To allow the charger cable to be seen
To stop the plates from freezing
To release explosive gases and prevent explosions
To keep the acid solution cool
mc.explain_ru: Дословный ответ курса: Release EXPLOSIVE GASES and prevent explosions. При зарядке электролит "кипит" и выделяет взрывоопасный газ.
mc.source: Разд. 5: Release EXPLOSIVE GASES and prevent explosions

mc.q: What must you do before refuelling a fuel-powered forklift?
options: Raise the mast fully
Leave the engine idling so the tank vents
Apply the handbrake only and stay seated
Turn off the engine
mc.explain_ru: Перед заправкой обязательно turn off the engine, иначе высок риск: fuel igniting, vapours igniting, gases igniting.
mc.source: Разд. 6: Refuelling — turn off the engine

mc.q: A co-worker gives you a hand signal you do not understand. What do you do?
options: Stop the forklift and ask to repeat the signal
Continue with the task you were already doing
Sound the horn twice and drive to the supervisor
Guess the most likely meaning and keep moving
mc.explain_ru: Правильный ответ: Stop the forklift and ask to repeat the signal — остановиться и попросить повторить сигнал, не додумывать.
mc.source: Разд. 6: Stop the forklift and ask to repeat the signal

mc.q: When is the pre-start inspection carried out?
options: Immediately after you turn on the ignition
Only at the end of the shift
Before you turn on the forklift
Once a week before the first shift
mc.explain_ru: Pre-start выполняется BEFORE YOU TURN ON — до поворота ключа. Проверки руля, тормозов, гудка и т.д. делаются уже после включения зажигания.
mc.source: Разд. 8: осмотр выполняется BEFORE YOU TURN ON

mc.q: Which of these checks is done AFTER you turn on the ignition?
options: Fork locking pins
Chains
Reverse beeper
Tyres and wheels
mc.explain_ru: После включения зажигания проверяют: steering, brakes, horn, lights, hydraulic levers, gauges, reverse beeper. Шины, цепи, вилы, фиксаторы — визуальный осмотр ДО включения.
mc.source: Разд. 9: семь проверок после TURN ON the ignition

mc.q: Why must all pneumatic tyres be inflated to the same working pressure?
options: To stop the tyres wearing out the brakes
To reduce fuel consumption
To keep the forklift AND load stable
To make the steering lighter
mc.explain_ru: Причина одинакового давления: To keep the forklift AND load stable — чтобы и погрузчик, и груз оставались устойчивыми.
mc.source: Разд. 8: Why same tyre pressure? To keep the forklift AND load stable

mc.q: During the pre-start you find the data plate is unreadable. What three actions must you take?
options: Remove the key, tag it 'out of service', report to a supervisor
Tag it 'out of service', keep working carefully, report at the end of the day
Stop the forklift, report to a supervisor, finish the shift
Take a photo, report to a supervisor, park it on a ramp
mc.explain_ru: На pre-start при обнаружении дефекта — три действия: вынуть ключ, повесить бирку "out of service", доложить супервайзеру.
mc.source: Разд. 8: Remove the key / Tag "out of service" / Report to a supervisor

mc.q: What does the LOAD GUARD protect?
options: The hydraulic hoses from the forks
The mast and operator from the load
The operator's head from falling objects
The tyres from damaged racking
mc.explain_ru: Load guard защищает мачту и оператора от груза. Overhead guard — голову оператора от падающих предметов.
mc.source: Разд. 9: Load guard protects the mast and operator from the load

mc.q: What does the OVERHEAD GUARD protect?
options: The operator from the rear end swing
The operator's head from falling objects
The engine from overhead light fixtures
The load from the mast
mc.explain_ru: Overhead guard защищает голову оператора от падающих предметов; он же является защитной клеткой при опрокидывании.
mc.source: Разд. 9: Overhead guard protects the operators head from falling objects

mc.q: Your view is obstructed by the load. Which three actions does the course require?
options: Lean out of the cabin, use a mirror, drive slowly
Travel in reverse, use a spotter, repack the load
Tilt the mast forward, use a spotter, sound the horn
Raise the load higher, sound the horn, drive slowly
mc.explain_ru: При закрытом обзоре: Travel in reverse, Use a spotter, Repack the load (если это безопасно).
mc.source: Разд. 10: Travel in reverse / Use a spotter / Repack the load

mc.q: At what height must a load be carried while travelling?
options: At mast mid-height so the forks clear obstacles
At the height of the load guard
At axle height or as low as possible
At least 1 metre above the ground
mc.explain_ru: Безопасная высота при движении: At axle height OR As low as possible. Высоко поднятый груз даёт риск — the forklift could tip over.
mc.source: Разд. 10: At axle height OR As low as possible

mc.q: You are taking a loaded forklift DOWN a ramp. How do you do it?
options: Turn side-on and drive across the ramp slowly
Travel in reverse, with the load still facing up the ramp
Drive forwards with the load facing down the ramp
Drive forwards but with the mast tilted fully forward
mc.explain_ru: Груз всегда обращён вверх по склону (load must face up the ramp), поэтому вниз спускаются задним ходом. Поворачивать на рампе с грузом нельзя.
mc.source: Разд. 10: подъём — вперёд; спуск — задним ходом; Load must face UP the ramp

mc.q: Where is the FULCRUM of a counter-balance forklift?
options: At the rear steering axle
The front tyres touching the ground
Under the operator's seat
At the centre of the mast
mc.explain_ru: Fulcrum — точка опоры "качелей": The front tyres touching the ground. Не мачта, не ось, не центр машины.
mc.source: Разд. 11: Where is the fulcrum? The front tyres touching the ground

mc.q: Which of the following is listed as a cause of tipping over SIDEWAYS?
options: Turning with a load raised
Braking severely
Driving overloaded
Having too much forward tilt with the load raised
mc.explain_ru: В списке "вбок" почти всё связано с поворотом: turning too fast, turning on ramps, turning with a load raised, side shift not centred. Остальные три варианта — из списка опрокидывания ВПЕРЁД.
mc.source: Разд. 11: причины опрокидывания вбок — TURNING with a load raised

mc.q: Which of the following is listed as a cause of tipping over FORWARDS?
options: Turning on ramps
Side shift not centred
Having the load too far forward on the forks (not against the heels)
Turning too fast
mc.explain_ru: Список "вперёд": driving overloaded, braking severely, load too high, driving too fast, uneven surface, unbalanced load, too much forward tilt with the load raised, load too far forward on the forks.
mc.source: Разд. 11: Having the load too far forward on the forks (not against heels)

mc.q: The forklift is tipping over sideways. What are the three correct actions?
options: Jump clear away from the tipping side, roll and stand up
Undo the seat belt, hold the overhead guard, jump out
Stay in the forklift, lean towards the tipping side, sound the horn
Stay in the forklift, brace yourself, lean away from the tipping side
mc.explain_ru: IN CASE OF TIP OVER: Stay in the forklift (NEVER JUMP OUT), Brace yourself, Lean away from the tipping side — иначе вас раздавит машиной.
mc.source: Разд. 11: Stay in the forklift / Brace yourself / Lean away from tipping side

mc.q: What is the function of the seat belt?
options: To stop you falling out in an accident
To keep the operator sitting upright for better vision
To activate the reverse beeper
To hold the operator in place while lifting a load
mc.explain_ru: Функция ремня по курсу: To stop you falling out in an accident — не дать выпасть при аварии, оставив оператора внутри защитной клетки.
mc.source: Разд. 11: Function of the seatbelt? To stop you falling out in an accident

mc.q: What are the three rules for a stable stack?
options: A sloping surface for drainage, lightest goods on the bottom, wrap the stack
Any hard surface, mixed weights, keep the stack under 3 layers
A flat level surface, heaviest goods on the top, tie the stack down
A flat level surface, heaviest goods on the bottom, keep the stack stable
mc.explain_ru: Три правила штабелирования: A flat level surface, Heaviest goods on the bottom, Keep the stack stable.
mc.source: Разд. 12: три правила устойчивого штабеля

mc.q: What is a JIB used for?
options: Clamp large rolls of paper or tyres
Elevate people to perform maintenance
Pick up 200L drums
Swing odd shaped loads such as engine blocks or gearboxes
mc.explain_ru: Jib используется для перемещения грузов необычной формы — блоков двигателей, коробок передач. Он же даёт a lower capacity и a swinging load.
mc.source: Разд. 13: Jib — Swing odd shaped loads such as engine blocks or gearboxes

mc.q: A 3000 mm carpet spike is fitted. What is the effect on the forklift and why?
options: It reduces/lowers the capacity due to having a greater load centre distance
It has no effect as long as the load is light
It reduces capacity only when the mast is vertical
It increases capacity because the attachment adds weight to the front
mc.explain_ru: Любое навесное снижает грузоподъёмность (Reduce / Lower the capacity), а carpet spike особенно — due to having a greater load centre distance.
mc.source: Разд. 8/13: Reduce / Lower the capacity due to having a greater load centre distance

mc.q: Why must the side shift be 'centralised' when carrying a load?
options: To allow the load guard to fold down
To make the reverse beeper audible
To prevent the hydraulic hoses twisting
To keep the forklift AND load stable
mc.explain_ru: Side shift всегда возвращают в центральное положение — To keep the forklift AND load stable. Несцентрованный side shift входит в причины опрокидывания вбок.
mc.source: Разд. 13: Why centralise the side shift? To keep the forklift AND load stable

mc.q: A truck is backed into a loading dock and there is a gap between the truck and the dock. What must be placed over the gap before shifting a load?
options: High impact barriers
Timber pallets laid flat
Dock plates or bridge plates
Rubber wheel chocks
mc.explain_ru: Зазор между грузовиком и доком перекрывают Dock Plates ИЛИ Bridge Plates — до того, как начнёте перемещать груз.
mc.source: Разд. 14: Dock Plates OR Bridge Plates

mc.q: You suffer a catastrophic (major) failure of the brakes, steering or hydraulics while operating. What TWO things must you do?
options: Park it on a ramp with the forks lowered and call the manufacturer
Drive it slowly back to the workshop and report at the end of the shift
Stop the forklift and tag it 'out of service', then report to a supervisor
Remove the key, tag it 'out of service' and report to a supervisor
mc.explain_ru: При отказе во время работы — ровно 2 действия: Stop forklift & Tag "out of service", Report to a supervisor. Три действия (с изъятием ключа) — это про находку дефекта на pre-start.
mc.source: Разд. 14: 1. Stop forklift & Tag out of service 2. Report to a supervisor

mc.q: How is the LOAD CENTRE DISTANCE measured?
options: From the front axle to the centre of the load
From the fork tips to the load's centre of gravity
From the mast to the front edge of the pallet
From the vertical face (heel) of the forks to the load's centre of gravity
mc.explain_ru: Load centre distance измеряется from the vertical face (heel) of the forks to the load's centre of gravity — от пятки вил до центра тяжести груза.
mc.source: Разд. 15: from the vertical face (heel) of the forks to the load's centre of gravity

mc.q: Why are most Australian forklifts rated at a load centre distance of 600 mm?
options: Because 600 mm is the maximum reach of the mast
Because it is half the width of a standard 1200 mm x 1200 mm pallet
Because it is half the tread width of the forklift
Because it is the standard fork length
mc.explain_ru: 600 мм — половина стандартного поддона 1200 x 1200 мм; равномерно уложенный груз имеет центр тяжести ровно на 600 мм от пятки вил.
mc.source: Разд. 15: 600 мм — половина ширины стандартного поддона 1200 x 1200 мм

mc.q: On a data plate, what does DIM C represent?
options: The horizontal load centre = load length divided by 2
The rated capacity with the mast tilted forward
The vertical load centre = load height divided by 2
The load height (lift height)
mc.explain_ru: DIM A — Load Height (высота подъёма), DIM B — горизонтальный load centre (длина/ширина ÷ 2), DIM C — вертикальный load centre (высота ÷ 2).
mc.source: Разд. 15: DIM C — вертикальный load centre = высота груза / 2

mc.q: The load is not placed hard against the heels of the forks. What are the two possible effects?
options: A higher capacity or a smoother ride
A lower capacity or the forklift could tip over
Reduced lift height or slower hydraulics
Increased rear end swing or fork damage only
mc.explain_ru: Если груз не прижат к пяткам вил: A lower capacity ИЛИ The forklift could tip over — плечо груза становится длиннее и перевешивает противовес.
mc.source: Разд. 15: A lower capacity OR The forklift could tip over

mc.q: Before lifting, which TWO things must be checked against the data plate?
options: The load weight (kg) and the load centres (mm)
The load weight (kg) and the fuel level
The load centres (mm) and the tyre pressures
The lift height and the operator's licence class
mc.explain_ru: Два условия: 1) The load weight (kg) 2) The load centres (mm) — DIM B и DIM C. Поднимать можно только если оба "ДА".
mc.source: Разд. 15: 1. The load weight 2. The load centres

mc.q: A data plate shows 1070 mm Forks and Side shift, fork height 4200 mm, load centre 600 mm: rated capacity 2500 kg with MAST VERTICAL. What is the rated capacity with MAST FORWARD TILT 5 DEGREES?
mc.explain_ru: Наклон мачты вперёд снижает грузоподъёмность: 2500 кг при вертикальной мачте и 2050 кг при наклоне 5 градусов (пример из курса и шпаргалки).
mc.source: Разд. 15, data plate example: MAST VERTICAL 2500 kg / MAST FORWARD TILT 5 DEGREES 2050 kg

mc.q: A pallet has five bags to a layer and eight layers. Each bag is 25 kg and the pallet weighs 30 kg. What is the grand total weight?
mc.explain_ru: 5 x 8 = 40 мешков; 40 x 25 = 1000 кг; 1000 + 30 = 1030 кг. Вес поддона добавляется последним — забыть его типичная ошибка.

mc.q: A load is 1200 mm long and 1500 mm high. What are DIM B and DIM C?
options: DIM B = 750 mm, DIM C = 600 mm
DIM B = 600 mm, DIM C = 1500 mm
DIM B = 1200 mm, DIM C = 1500 mm
DIM B = 600 mm, DIM C = 750 mm
mc.explain_ru: Оба размера считаются делением пополам: 1200 / 2 = 600 мм (DIM B, горизонтальный), 1500 / 2 = 750 мм (DIM C, вертикальный).
mc.source: Разд. 15, пример: Length 1200mm -> 600 mm DIM B; Height 1500mm -> 750 mm DIM C

mc.q: A forklift is rated at 4200 kg with a 600 mm load centre. Three loads each weigh 4200 kg: Load A is 1400 mm wide, Load B is 1000 mm wide, Load C is 1300 mm wide. Which load can be lifted?
options: All three, because they all weigh exactly 4200 kg
Load A, because 1400 / 2 = 700 mm
Load B, because 1000 / 2 = 500 mm
Load C, because 1300 / 2 = 650 mm
mc.explain_ru: Формула: ширина / 2 = load centre. A = 700 мм и C = 650 мм больше 600 мм, значит нельзя. Только Load B (500 мм) вписывается — вес у всех одинаковый, решает load centre.
mc.source: Разд. 15: Load A 700 mm x, Load B 500 mm v, Load C 650 mm x

mc.q: A sea container has a tare of 5000 kg, the load inside is 7000 kg, and it is 2.5 m wide and 2.6 m high. The forklift is rated 9000 kg at DIM B 1200 mm and DIM C 1200 mm. Can it be lifted?
options: Yes, weight and both load centres are within limits
No, but only because 2.6 m height gives DIM C of 1300 mm
No, the total weight is 12000 kg and both load centres (1250 mm and 1300 mm) exceed 1200 mm
Yes, because the container length of 2.5 m is not used in the calculation
mc.explain_ru: 5000 + 7000 = 12000 кг (tare прибавляется!). DIM B = 2500 / 2 = 1250 мм > 1200; DIM C = 2600 / 2 = 1300 мм > 1200. Превышено всё три — ответ NO.
mc.source: Разд. 16, Задача B: 12000 kg, 1250 mm, 1300 mm -> NO!

mc.q: Where must you NOT park a forklift?
options: Near emergency exits, fire extinguishers or first aid stations
On flat level concrete inside the warehouse
Next to the battery charging station
In a designated forklift parking bay
mc.explain_ru: Пять запрещённых зон: near first aid stations, near emergency exits, near fire extinguishers, on ramps, on walkways — нельзя перекрывать эвакуацию и доступ к средствам спасения.
mc.source: Разд. 17: пять зон, где парковка запрещена

mc.q: What is the FIRST step of the shut down procedure when parking the forklift?
options: Tilt the forks forward and lower them to the ground
Put the transmission in neutral
Turn off the LPG cylinder
Remove the keys
mc.explain_ru: Порядок SHUT DOWN: 1) Tilt forks forward and lower to the ground, 2) Neutral gear, 3) Hand brake on, 4) Remove the keys, 5) Turn off the LPG cylinder, 6) Place battery on charge.
mc.source: Разд. 17: шаг 1 — Tilt forks forward and lower to the ground

mc.q: Why must the key always be removed at the end of the shift?
options: So the next operator must do a pre-start
To stop the battery from going flat
To keep the hydraulics pressurised
To prevent unauthorised use
mc.explain_ru: Дословный ответ: To prevent unauthorised use — предотвратить несанкционированное использование.
mc.source: Разд. 17: Why remove the key? To prevent unauthorised use

mc.q: Who is most at risk in an area where forklifts operate?
options: Other forklift operators
Pedestrians
Supervisors
Truck drivers
mc.explain_ru: Курс прямо говорит: Pedestrians are most at risk. Поэтому применяют надземные переходы, размеченные дорожки, барьеры, переходы, столбики и калитки.
mc.source: Разд. 17: Pedestrians are most at risk

mc.q: What is the typical site speed limit an operator must keep to at all times?
options: 15 km/h
5 km/h
10 km/h
20 km/h
mc.explain_ru: Типовое ограничение: Keep to a speed limit of 5 km/h at all times. Знаки ограничения скорости — белые, красные и чёрные.
mc.source: Разд. 17: Keep to a speed limit of 5 km/h at all times

mc.q: What colour are the warning signs and the painted pedestrian walkways/crossings in a forklift area?
options: Green and white
Bright yellow
Red and black
Blue and white
mc.explain_ru: Предупреждающие знаки о погрузчиках и разметка пешеходных зон и переходов — ярко-жёлтые. Белые, красные и чёрные — это знаки ограничения скорости.
mc.source: Разд. 17: три цветовых кода — знаки и разметка ярко-жёлтые

mc.q: What is the risk of raising or lowering a load over people?
options: Risk of injury or death if the load falls
Risk of damaging the overhead guard only
Risk of a lower capacity reading on the data plate
Risk of the reverse beeper being masked by noise
mc.explain_ru: Поднимать или опускать груз над людьми нельзя никогда: Risk of injury or death if load falls.
mc.source: Разд. 10: Risk of injury or death if load falls

tasks.q: You have 4 steel drums of water. Each drum weighs 212 kg and they are on a pallet weighing 45 kg. What is the total weight of this load?
tasks.q_ru: 4 стальные бочки по 212 кг на паллете весом 45 кг. Общий вес груза?
steps: 4 drums × 212 kg = 848 kg
848 kg + 45 kg (pallet) = 893 kg
Total load = 893 kg — always add the pallet

tasks.q: There are 6 cartons per layer and 6 layers on a pallet, each carton weighs 36 kg. The load is placed on a pallet weighing 40 kg. What is the total weight of this load?
tasks.q_ru: 6 коробок в слое, 6 слоёв, каждая коробка 36 кг, паллет 40 кг. Общий вес?
steps: 6 cartons × 6 layers = 36 cartons
1296 kg + 40 kg (pallet) = 1336 kg

tasks.q: A load contains 56 boxes, each box weighs 33 kg, placed on a pallet weighing 42 kg. What is the total weight of this load?
tasks.q_ru: 56 коробок по 33 кг на паллете 42 кг. Общий вес?
steps: 1848 kg + 42 kg (pallet) = 1890 kg

tasks.part: Part 3 — Load chart / data plate XTQ300a
tasks.plate: XTQ300a · max height 3700 mm · max back tilt 10° · forks 1070 mm · load centre 600 mm · SWL mast vertical 1890 kg · SWL mast forward tilt 6° 1480 kg
tasks.q: What is the lifting capacity of the forklift with the mast tilted forward 6 degrees?
tasks.q_ru: Грузоподъёмность при наклоне мачты вперёд на 6°?
steps: Read the 'MAST FORWARD TILT 6 DEGREES' table: Safe Working Load = 1480 kg
Tilting the mast forward moves the load centre forward → capacity drops from 1890 to 1480 kg

tasks.part: Part 3 — Load chart / data plate XTQ300a
tasks.q: What is the lifting capacity of the forklift with the mast in the vertical position?
steps: Read the 'MAST VERTICAL' table: Safe Working Load = 1890 kg at 600 mm load centre

tasks.part: Part 3 — Load chart / data plate XTQ300a
tasks.q: Can a load weighing 1890 kg with a load centre of 700 mm be raised with the mast in the vertical position?
tasks.q_ru: Можно ли поднять 1890 кг с load centre 700 мм при вертикальной мачте?
steps: 1890 kg is the capacity at 600 mm load centre only
At 700 mm the capacity is lower: ≈ 1890 × 600 ÷ 700 ≈ 1620 kg
1890 kg > 1620 kg → NO, it is an overload

Anything heavier is an overload → NO

tasks.q: Can you lift a pallet 1175 mm length and 1175 mm width with a height of 1600 mm and a total weight of 1700 kg?
tasks.q_ru: Можно ли поднять паллет 1175 × 1175 мм, высота 1600 мм, вес 1700 кг?
steps: Load centre = 1175 ÷ 2 = 587.5 mm — inside the rated 915 mm (Dim. B)
Vertical load centre: 1600 ÷ 2 = 800 mm — inside Dim. C 915 mm
Weight 1700 kg < 6130 kg → YES

tasks.q: A container containing a 6000 kg load. The tare weight of the container is 2500 kg. The container size is 2.4 m wide, 2.5 m high and 2.4 m long. Can you lift it?
tasks.q_ru: Контейнер: груз 6000 кг, тара 2500 кг, размер 2,4 × 2,5 × 2,4 м. Можно поднять?
steps: Total weight = 6000 + 2500 (tare) = 8500 kg
8500 kg > 6130 kg maximum capacity → NO
Also the load centre 2400 ÷ 2 = 1200 mm is beyond the rated 915 mm — capacity would be even lower

options: A
B
C
steps: Load centre = half the load length
A: 700 mm → ≈ 3600 kg capacity → overload
B: 500 mm → inside 600 mm → 4200 kg OK
C: 650 mm → ≈ 3877 kg → overload
